item.title: Pocket Host 0.17.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • Code blocks in replies have a copy button in their corner that copies the code without its fences, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android. On the Mac, text in the chat can now be selected with the pointer: paragraphs, headings, list items, table cells and code blocks of replies, your own messages, the agent's questions and tool output. Copy it with ⌘C or a right-click; the right-click menu on a message offers Copy (the selection), Copy Message and Select Text.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.16.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • Attach photos, videos and files to the first message of a new workspace ("Attach" under the message, or drop them onto the form on the Mac and iPad). Pocket Host creates the workspace, waits for its folder and then sends the message with them. Needs the new Pocket Host.

    • Patch Changes

  • Answering the agent's question from Pocket works again when the question or an option contains quotes or other Markdown, which Conductor shows typeset ("QMO" as “QMO”). Pocket Host used to report "Conductor is not showing the agent's question".

item.title: Pocket Host 0.15.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #62 `8be0555` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Pocket Host: "Darken the screen" (menu → Screen and sleep) turns every display black (and the backlight of the built-in display, LG UltraFine and Studio Display all the way down) while the phone keeps working, instead of the screen lighting up with each send. Meanwhile the Mac's mouse does nothing and any key brings the picture back, or, with an unlock code set, only that code.
  • #62 `8be0555` Thanks @GarreltMock! - Get notifications only for what you sent from Pocket: Settings → Notifications → "Only for messages from Pocket" leaves out the turns you started at the Mac. iPhone, iPad and Mac only, as Android has no notifications yet.

    • Patch Changes

  • Pocket on the Mac: a right-click on your own message now offers Copy and Select Text as well, as it does on agent replies. Before, it only showed the system's text menu. Attached files are copied by their name. iPhone, iPad and Android stay as they are.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.14.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • Pocket on the Mac: a right-click on an agent message offers Copy (the whole message) and Select Text, which opens it in a text view where any part can be selected and copied with ⌘C. The Mac app couldn't select text in replies at all. iPhone, iPad and Android stay as they are.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.14.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • Pocket also runs on a Mac, for working on Conductor from another Mac such as a MacBook: the iPad layout, through Mac Catalyst. Click Copy pairing link in Pocket Host and Paste pairing link in Pocket to pair. It comes through TestFlight on the Mac once the release has a Mac profile; Android has no counterpart.
  • Typing "/" in the message box lists the chat's slash commands and skills with what they take and do, like Conductor's "/" menu; a tap puts one in the box. On iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android; needs the new Pocket Host.

    • Patch Changes

  • Pocket on the Mac: the chat fills the window instead of a narrow column, and the message box sits further from the window's bottom edge. On the Mac and iPad, photos, videos and files dragged onto the message box become attachments, as if picked with "+"; not on Android yet.
